_about: Scientific data library, domain plants: one table per species (binomial in snake_case). Each Value is labelled researched (opened page, URL given), estimate (stated basis in Note plus a flag line) or fiction; a value with neither stays null with a searched: line in flags/plants.md. Validation studies live in validation.json table plants_validation, never here.
